premises.text: There is a market for local content streaming in Tanzania
premises.evidence_span: we are building a media streaming platform for mostly local content

premises.text: Tango TV can be accessed on mobile phones and TVs
premises.evidence_span: You can stream Tango TV on your mobile phone. We have an amazing mobile app. And on your TV.

premises.text: Tango TV has established relationships with content creators in Tanzania
premises.evidence_span: we already have a good relationship with content creators in Tanzania

premises.text: The business model includes a royalty-based payment system for content creators
premises.evidence_span: when a user pays for a movie, that's when the content creator says, hey, my movie was watched 10 times, so you should pay me this much money

value.text: Local content is accessible to users through a streaming platform
value.evidence_span: we are building a media streaming platform for mostly local content
